features.title: Arcade catalog browser
features.description: Searchable landing-page catalog of games with live filtering, results count, empty state, and links to each game's detail page.

features.title: Game detail page
features.description: Per-game page that reads ?game=<slug>, renders genre/title/description, shows a missing-game state and a placeholder for unimplemented games, and mounts the solitaire game for the Canvas Solitaire slug.

features.title: Canvas Klondike Solitaire
features.description: Fully playable Klondike solitaire on a <canvas>: shuffle/deal, stock/waste draw and recycle, foundations A-K, tableau drag-and-drop of validated runs, click-to-auto-foundation, flip face-down cards, responsive scaling, win detection, restart.

remainder.reason: Cross-cutting slug-derivation invariant duplicated in main.ts and game.ts, linking catalog to detail.
Shared color/theme tokens are cross-cutting; the rest is feature-specific styling.
Actual build stack and deploy posture.

remainder.item: static assets (hero.png, vite.svg, typescript.svg, icons.svg, favicon.svg)
